scripts.build: npm run build:tracker && npm run build:datastore
scripts.check:python: uv lock --project packages/input-analyzer --check && uv run --directory packages/input-analyzer --frozen --all-extras ruff check . && uv run --directory packages/input-analyzer --frozen --all-extras ruff format --check . && uv run --directory packages/input-analyzer --frozen --all-extras ty check && npm run test:python
scripts.check:python-package: npm run build:python && uv run --directory packages/input-analyzer --frozen python scripts/check_distribution.py
scripts.test: npm run test:datastore && npm run test --workspace input-tracker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @input-analyzer/datastore && npm run typecheck --workspace input-tracker
